context_stem: Monitoring pretraining: We will not train models with comparable or greater capabilities...
excerpt: If the pretraining model's capabilities are comparable or greater, we will pause training until we have implemented the ASL-3 Security Standard and established it is sufficient for the model.
paraphrase: If pretraining capabilities match or exceed the threshold, Anthropic will pause training until ASL-3 Security Standard is implemented and confirmed sufficient.

context_stem: Monitoring pretraining: We will not train models with comparable or greater capabilities...
excerpt: We will set expectations with internal stakeholders about the potential for such pauses.
paraphrase: Anthropic will inform internal stakeholders in advance about the possibility of such training pauses.

excerpt: To facilitate the effective implementation of this policy across the company, we commit to the following:
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to a set of internal governance measures to support effective implementation of the policy.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: The ASLs specify what has to be true substantively of our models and our security to allow safe training and deployment of those models. To ensure this system is implemented in a transparent and trustworthy manner, we additionally make the following procedural commitments.

excerpt: Responsible Scaling Officer: We will maintain the position of Responsible Scaling Officer, a designated member of staff who is responsible for reducing catastrophic risk, primarily by ensuring this policy is designed and implemented effectively.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain a Responsible Scaling Officer role responsible for reducing catastrophic risk through effective policy implementation.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Responsible Scaling Officer. There is a designated member of staff responsible for ensuring that our Responsible Scaling Commitments are executed properly.

context_stem: The Responsible Scaling Officer's duties will include (but are not limited to):
excerpt: (1) as needed, proposing updates to this policy to the Board of Directors; (2) approving relevant model training or deployment decisions based on capability and safeguard assessments; (3) reviewing major contracts (i.e., deployment partnerships) for consistency with this policy;
paraphrase: The RSO's duties include proposing policy updates, approving training/deployment decisions, and reviewing major contracts for policy consistency.

context_stem: The Responsible Scaling Officer's duties will include (but are not limited to):
excerpt: (4) overseeing implementation of this policy, including the allocation of sufficient resources; (5) receiving and addressing reports of potential instances of noncompliance; (6) promptly notifying the Board of Directors of any cases of noncompliance that pose material risk; and (7) making judgment calls on policy interpretation and application.
paraphrase: The RSO's duties also include overseeing implementation and resourcing, handling noncompliance reports, notifying the Board of material noncompliance, and making interpretive judgment calls.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Distribution partnership contracts will be verified for compatibility with the ASL system and must have a mechanism to bind the partner's use of Anthropic models to the same or similar safety measures as Anthropic (e.g. similar security measures) in order to address catastrophic risks.

excerpt: We consider implementation of the ASL-3 Security Standard alone sufficient to continue training, regardless of whether the ASL-3 Deployment Standard is satisfied. "Comparable or greater capabilities" is operationalized as 1x or more in Effective Compute.
paraphrase: A footnote clarifies that ASL-3 Security Standard alone suffices to continue training and defines comparable capability as 1x or more Effective Compute.

excerpt: In addition to noncompliance processes, we will (1) establish pathways for Anthropic staff to raise any issues related to this policy, including the overall risk levels of our models and implementation challenges; and (2) regularly review our compliance with this policy's procedural requirements.
paraphrase: Beyond noncompliance handling, Anthropic will create staff channels to raise policy-related issues and will regularly review compliance with procedural requirements.

excerpt: Cases deemed to present minimal additional risk may be reported to the Board in quarterly summary reports.
paraphrase: Low-risk noncompliance cases may instead be reported quarterly in summary to the Board.

excerpt: In cases where this policy is unintentionally ambiguous, we will act in accordance with the Responsible Scaling Officer or CEO's judgment, and aim to clarify the ambiguity in the next policy update.
paraphrase: Ambiguities in the policy will be resolved via RSO or CEO judgment, with clarification intended for the next update.

excerpt: Readiness: We will develop internal safety procedures for incident scenarios. Such scenarios include (1) pausing training in response to reaching Capability Thresholds; (2) responding to a security incident involving model weights; and (3) responding to severe jailbreaks or vulnerabilities in deployed models, including restricting access in safety emergencies that cannot otherwise be mitigated.
paraphrase: Anthropic will develop internal procedures for incident scenarios including training pauses, weight security incidents, and severe jailbreaks or vulnerabilities.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Document and test internal safety procedures. This includes pausing training in response to evaluation warning signs, restricting internal model access, safety review of new training runs and deployments, and responding to vulnerabilities in deployed models (including, for ASL-3+ models, the ability to restrict access in the case of an extreme safety emergency that cannot otherwise be mitigated).

excerpt: We will run exercises to ensure our readiness for incident scenarios.
paraphrase: Anthropic will conduct exercises to test readiness for incident scenarios.

excerpt: Transparency: We will share summaries of Capability Reports and Safeguards Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff, redacting any highly-sensitive information. We will share a minimally redacted version of these reports with a subset of staff, to help us surface relevant technical safety considerations.
paraphrase: Anthropic will share redacted report summaries broadly with staff and minimally redacted versions with a subset of staff to surface safety considerations.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Publicly share evaluation results after model deployment where possible, in some cases in the initial model card, in other cases with a delay if it serves a broad safety interest.

excerpt: Internal review: For each Capabilities or Safeguards Report, we will solicit feedback from internal teams with visibility into the relevant activities, with the aims of informing future refinements to our methodology and, in some circumstances, identifying weaknesses and informing the CEO and RSO's decisions.
paraphrase: Anthropic will solicit internal feedback on each report to refine methodology and inform CEO/RSO decisions.
